title: Bad structured output: is it syntax or meaning?
head: What you observe
Kind of error
Fix
rows: Tool use with JSON schema (forced tool)
Validate in code, retry with the specific error
Required field filled with invented data
Model answers in prose, no tool call
Field truly absent from the source
rule: Tool use with a schema stops broken JSON. It does not stop wrong values; check those in code.

title: Wrong value extracted: was it misread, or never there?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Field absent from the source, schema requires it
Validate against system of record, retry
Retries can't find what isn't there
rule: Required means 'produce something'. If the document may not contain the value, make the field nullable.

title: A value does not fit the schema: what kind of mismatch is it?
head: Situation
Schema design
Why
rows: Mostly fixed list, some unpredictable values
A small, known, fixed set of extra codes
Value not present in the document
Model unsure between two valid values
rule: Closed lists break on open worlds. Add other plus a detail field, and keep the exact text.

title: tool_choice: what exactly must the reply be?
head: Need
Setting
Note
rows: Model may answer in text or call a tool
Must call a tool; only one fits
Fine when one tool is attached
Must call a tool; several attached
Forced tool on the first request
Empty result must still be structured
Forced tool + empty array in schema
rule: auto allows text; "any" requires some tool; forced requires that tool. With several tools attached, force the one you need.

title: Schema passes but the value is wrong: what kind of error is it?
head: What you observe
Kind of error
What catches it
rows: Value has the wrong format (bad length, letters in a number)
Value not in the document at all
Nullable field, route to a person
rule: Strict schemas remove syntax errors, not semantic ones. After adopting one, the remaining errors look correct, so you need checks on meaning.

title: The schema can't hold what the document says: which escape hatch?
head: What the document says
Schema fix
Why
rows: A clear value outside the enum, many variants
Text that can't be read with confidence
A clear value that fits, but mapped inconsistently
rule: Null when the document says nothing; other plus detail when it says something clear that the list doesn't cover; unclear when the text itself is ambiguous.

title: Tool-calling failure: wrong tool, or no tool?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Model replies in text, picks the right tool when it calls
Better descriptions, or classify then force
A specific tool must run first
Must never call a tool in some step
rule: auto may answer in text; any must call some tool; forced must call that one. If selection is right and only text slips through, use any.

title: Invented values: is the schema forcing the guess?
head: What you observe
Cause
Fix
rows: Value often absent; field is required
Field optional, model still fills it
Value printed but outside an enum's list
Value present but in a wrong field
rule: Absent value + required field = fabrication. Make the field nullable before anything else.

title: Value doesn't fit the schema: absent, or just unlisted?
head: Situation
Schema fix
Why
rows: Value printed, outside a growing list
Value ambiguous between two listed options
Small fixed set, one value missing
rule: Present but unlisted → other + detail. Absent → null.
